scenes.title: New Year's Eve, late
scenes.summary: Flashback to the New Year's Eve before the arrest: Arkady arrives late at home with Pasha, who 'is all alone'; Vika is hurt because he promised a New Year for two; Arkady insists it's a family holiday, like in childhood, and hurries everyone in before the president's speech.

scenes.title: Exactly forty
scenes.summary: Same night: Arkady shows Pasha a pyramid of cash; Pasha guesses 'forty' (million) and is mocked, so Arkady removes a pile to make it exactly forty; when Pasha suggests investing, Arkady hands him a 'bonus'; then he slips out for an hour and a half, tells Pasha to keep Vika company and has the power cut in three districts so his excuse holds. Opening song.

scenes.title: I'm not a thief
scenes.summary: Present day, in the communal kitchen: over vodka Arkady coaches Samson for the mayor's race, teaching him to say at rallies that he is not a thief, and explains that 'thief' is just a word: it's business.

scenes.title: A sleepless night
scenes.summary: At night Arkady can't sleep, hates every object in his old room and wonders why he never changed his registration; the old neighbour Klavdia Viktorovna tells him he is in hell because he couldn't even steal properly.
scenes.location: communal flat, Arkady's room and corridor

scenes.title: Where's the money?
scenes.summary: Pasha wakes Vika in the night and demands Arkady's money; she shows him a stash of about three million, but the big money is gone and she doesn't know where.

scenes.title: The morning queue
scenes.summary: Morning queue for the shared toilet: Arkady pushes in front of a little boy, Lyosha; the boy's mother turns out to be Marina Sergeyevna, the lecturer from the monastery protest, who lives in the flat and calls him a bribe-taker.
scenes.location: communal flat, corridor by the toilet

scenes.title: Taken roughly
scenes.summary: Arkady's former guards burst in while he is still in the toilet and drag him off: they were ordered to bring him 'with frightening rudeness'.

scenes.title: Samson for mayor
scenes.summary: Samson, back from a cold dip, cheerfully tells Nina he will run for mayor in Arkady's place; Nina mocks him, tells him to apologise to his boss instead, and they quarrel.

scenes.title: Pasha's offer
scenes.summary: Pasha explains he needs Arkady's forty million for the Moscow cluster deal; he offers a suspended sentence and Vika's spare cash in return, Arkady refuses and threatens him, and Pasha gives him until evening before 'physical' methods.

scenes.title: No time for elections
scenes.summary: Back at the flat Samson wants to start the campaign, but Arkady says there is no time for the election plan and asks for a phone to call the governor; his own phone is blocked and Nina refuses to lend hers.

scenes.title: The Moscow partners
scenes.summary: At the airport Pasha meets the Moscow partners of the cluster deal: the money isn't ready; the angry Stepan Gennadyevich wants to move the project to Kaluga and keep Pasha's advance, and Pasha begs for three days.

scenes.title: Operation called off
scenes.summary: A radio voice calls off an undercover operation: the Moscow 'partners' are being watched by the security services.

scenes.title: Samson says sorry
scenes.summary: Samson apologises to his boss Nikolai Filippovich, who has fired him and can't forget being called names; when a delivery is blocked by heavy radiators and no workers are left, Samson offers to carry them himself.

scenes.title: The Moscow agents
scenes.summary: At local security headquarters Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov begs his uncle, the chief Mikhail Mikhailovich, for field work; two agents from Moscow, Major Lavrov and Captain Zavarzin, arrive after their failed operation, and the chief mocks them and calls Moscow.

scenes.title: The phone swap
scenes.summary: In the flat Arkady tries to borrow a phone from the children; his own iPhone is blocked by the court, so he trades it to Slavik for Slavik's old phone.

scenes.title: Operation Golden Yard
scenes.summary: On a video call General Kruglov learns the mayor has hidden the money; the Moscow agents explain operation 'Golden Yard' (the cluster is a cover story to seize a billion roubles in bribes); the general asks why the chief's nephew is at a secret meeting, and the operation continues.

scenes.title: Calling 'Pig'
scenes.summary: Arkady looks up the governor's number on the iPhone (saved under a rude nickname) and dials it on the old phone, sending the children out of the room.

scenes.title: The governor won't help
scenes.summary: Governor Viktor Stepanovich, in the middle of a judo session, knows Arkady has badmouthed him in Moscow; Arkady begs on his knees, lists his miseries and asks for help; the governor says only Tretyakov in Moscow can give the go-ahead and refuses to call him.

scenes.title: A judo photo
scenes.summary: The governor finishes a staged judo throw for a photo and has his aide post it online with a slogan.

scenes.title: The phone works
scenes.summary: Slavik shows off to a friend that he is calling on the brand-new iPhone: he simply switched on mobile data in the settings.

scenes.title: Ears in the flat
scenes.summary: The agents decide to watch the ex-mayor themselves and need an informer in the communal flat; the chief reads out profiles of the residents (the Samsonovs, Marina, old Klavdia), and Lyova is sent back to the archive again.

scenes.title: Fired
scenes.summary: Marina is lecturing when the dean calls her in and fires her, offering a job list (sales assistant in a phone shop); he insists he still loves her, then takes a call and forgets her.

scenes.title: The impression
scenes.summary: Arkady entertains the children with his impression of Tretyakov, the fearsome man in Moscow; Yulia suggests a number-spoofing app so he can call the governor 'as Tretyakov'; the app costs five hundred roubles and Arkady has nothing.

scenes.title: The piggy bank
scenes.summary: Arkady asks the children for money; Lyosha has a piggy bank (saving for a games console with his mum); Arkady promises him the best console in the world in exchange for five hundred roubles, pressures him, and Lyosha gives in.

scenes.title: The agents and Marina
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov and Captain Zavarzin approach Marina, who assumes they've come about her political opinions; they want her to report on Arkady and offer her job back and money; she refuses to be an informer but they leave a card. (Brief cutaway: Samson's crew helps with the radiators.)

scenes.title: Tickets to Crimea
scenes.summary: At the site Samson tells his boss Nikolai why he dislikes him: he pours Samson vodka and drinks French cognac himself; the boss, offended, gives Samson his union holiday vouchers for two to Crimea in March; the concrete delivery turns out bad.

scenes.title: A call from 'Tretyakov'
scenes.summary: In the governor's meeting everyone has to like his judo photo; then 'Tretyakov' calls (Arkady, using the spoofing app and his impression) and yells at the governor to release Anikeev immediately, then improvises a tale about a polar explorer's ashes.

scenes.title: A feast from the fridge
scenes.summary: Arkady marvels that he fixed it for five hundred roubles, is starving, breaks the lock on Klavdia's fridge and feasts on her delicacies with the children, telling Lyosha his 'caviar allergy' is just his mum being stingy. (Cutaway: Samson tells Nina about the Crimea trip.)

scenes.title: The allergy
scenes.summary: Arkady promises the children everything and calls Lyosha's mum a sucker; Lyosha has a severe allergic reaction; Marina rushes in and saves him, then learns about the piggy bank, throws Arkady out with a fierce warning, and he leaves with an ironic bow.

scenes.title: 'To court?'
scenes.summary: Officers come for Arkady; thinking he is being released, he gathers his things and says a gleeful goodbye to the flat.

scenes.title: Lunch with the governor
scenes.summary: Instead of freedom, Arkady is brought to the governor in a restaurant: Tretyakov called back and the trick came out; the governor makes him do the impression again, then tells him to give the money for the cluster because he is alone against everyone; Arkady refuses and leaves.

scenes.title: No console
scenes.summary: Back in the flat Samson admits to Nina that the job and the Crimea trip fell through; Arkady tells Lyosha there will be no console and takes his iPhone back from Slavik.

scenes.title: The guards say no
scenes.summary: At night Pasha comes with Arkady's former guards to force out the money; the guards refuse to touch Arkady, who once helped their family, and refuse Pasha's orders too: they don't work for him any more.

scenes.title: I've changed my mind
scenes.summary: A stranger asks if he is the mayor who broke his finger and has a business proposal; Marina phones the agents: she has changed her mind and agrees. Closing song.
